name: Hallowed Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, a message from Ken'jai reaches young priests after their first test. The tablet calls them to learn how Darkspear priests commune with the spirits.

sections.title: A Message from Ken'jai
sections.body: After you prove yourself against the boars under Gornek's watch, he gives you an inscribed stone called the Hallowed Tablet. Its message bears Ken'jai's mark. The Darkspear mystic waits outside the Den, where he watches over newcomers drawn to faith and spiritual magic.

sections.title: Communing with the Spirits
sections.body: Darkspear priests among the Horde seek communion with spirits and loa, unlike human and dwarven priests who follow the Holy Light across the sea. Ken'jai welcomes you to Durotar and teaches that your power grows through spiritual discipline. He will instruct you in greater rites as your bond with the spirits matures.

faq.answer: The Hallowed Tablet carries a message from Ken'jai, the troll priest trainer, for young priests in the Valley of Trials. Gornek keeps it until you prove your basic abilities in the valley.
Ken'jai is a Darkspear troll priest trainer outside the Den in the Valley of Trials. He teaches young initiates to commune with spirits and learn healing and shadowy spiritual arts.

faq.q: Why does a priest start out fighting mottled boars?
faq.answer: You prove basic self-reliance and survival skills before a specialist instructor spends time training you. Every initiate in the Valley of Trials faces this test, whatever their calling.

faq.q: How does Ken'jai's priesthood differ from the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Darkspear priests call on spirits and loa, while human and dwarven churches worship the Holy Light. Ken'jai teaches that they must keep favor with these unseen powers and live in harmony with them.
The Den is a hollowed cave settlement in the Valley of Trials in southern Durotar. Trainers and trial-masters use it as a hub for new Horde recruits.

faq.q: Can orcs become priests through this quest?
faq.answer: No. Only Darkspear trolls in the Valley of Trials have the spiritual traditions to train as priests under Ken'jai. Orcish culture instead follows shamanism and warlock magic.

angles.text: As a priest, you leave the valley's ordinary trials and begin formal spiritual instruction with Ken'jai outside the Den.
As a troll, you follow Darkspear traditions that honor ancestral spirits and loa, rather than the dogmatic ways of foreign priests.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep spiritual rites and the will of the spirits central as your people settle Durotar.
